def compare(game, guess):
    # 1. Parse input
    if len(game) != len(guess):
        raise ValueError("Input lists must be of the same length")
    
    # 2. Validate input
    if not all(isinstance(score, int) for score in game) or not all(isinstance(prediction, int) for prediction in guess):
        raise ValueError("Input lists must contain only integer values")
    
    # 3. Compare predictions
    deviations = [abs(game[i] - guess[i]) if game[i] != guess[i] else 0 for i in range(len(game))]
    
    # 4. Generate output
    return deviations
